title: Coverage ledger — the skill's per-item completeness state
description: Emitted by the threat-model run. The skill attempts every applicable taxonomy item and records a terminal state with evidence (present/partial) or a note (absent/not-applicable/unknown). The eval verifies structure only: every applicable item reached a terminal state, present is grounded, unknown is noted — it never requires a specific item to be present.
comment: top level tolerates descriptive provenance metadata (system_name, generated, summary, …) — the eval reads only context + items; required fields and their types are still validated

context.description: applicability flags the skill declared (which tier-2 sections apply). Drives gating so the eval reasons about declared facts, not inference.

source.description: repo path/glob/string(s) that resolve in the target — required for present/partial; a single source may be a bare string
